content.comment_body: Hello, I am having trouble selecting the correct hardware in [product_name] [version_no] for the [product_name] [article_no]. Can anyone explain how to add the proper hardware? When I refresh the online view, the PC recognizes the module as unknown. Thank you for your assistance.

You need to check which firmware version is installed on the [product_name]. Firmware versions V1.08.01 to V1.08.03 correspond to [article_no].[version_no], while firmware versions B1.81.01 to V1.81.03 match [product_name] [version_no] ([product_name] [version_no]).
Thanks a lot! How can I view the firmware version if I do not have a module with an integrated screen?
Start [product_name]. Navigate to Tools > Transfer > Show FW version.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face challenges adding particular [product_name] modules in [product_name] [version_no], especially when the hardware lacks a built-in display. The core issue involves determining the installed firmware version to ensure proper configuration within the software. Devices often show up as 'unknown' in the online interface, creating confusion over hardware recognition and version compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward method to identify and add correct hardware in [product_name] [version_no], even for modules without a display. They are looking for clear guidance on how to recognize and configure hardware using the software.
